facts_raw.Primary Value: Capital + Customer / Pilot Access + Market Entry
facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Commercial pilots, CMA CGM access, market-entry and fundraising support; investment opportunities through FF ecosystem
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: No single standardized deal publicly stated on current page
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early-stage maritime/logistics startup；技术应能服务 shipping/logistics industrial use case。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 有可部署产品；能明确与 CMA CGM / ports / shipping operator 的 pilot KPI；已有 B2B buyer hypothesis。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Global partnership；官方重点是 pilots/deployment，而非固定 residency。现场参与随 corporate pilot 决定。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 无统一 relocation/visa 要求；pilot 地点可能需要差旅。

facts_raw.Public Contact Route: Official Apply Now on program page.
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: Maritime / logistics startup，需要 CMA CGM pilot、first customer、commercial deployment 和国际扩张。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 与海运/物流无直接场景；还没有可以 pilot 的产品；只需要课堂式 accelerator。
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：适合硬件/AI/automation/green shipping 等明确产业场景；价值来自真实商业部署而非 cohort 品牌本身。

facts.Primary Value: Capital + Customer / Pilot Access + Market Entry
facts.Funding / Support: Commercial pilots, CMA CGM access, market-entry and fundraising support; investment opportunities through FF ecosystem
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: No single standardized deal publicly stated on current page
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early-stage maritime or logistics startups with technology addressing a shipping or logistics use case.
facts.Strong-to-Have: A deployable product, clear pilot metrics with CMA CGM, ports or shipping operators, and an identified B2B buyer.
facts.On-site / Attendance: A global partnership focused on pilots and deployment rather than a fixed residency. On-site participation depends on the corporate pilot.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard relocation or visa requirement; pilots may require travel.
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Official Apply Now on program page.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Maritime and logistics startups seeking CMA CGM pilots, first customers, commercial deployment and international expansion.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Teams without a shipping or logistics use case or a pilot-ready product, or seeking classroom instruction only.
facts.Notes: Best for hardware, AI, automation or green shipping with clear deployment opportunities. Value comes from real commercial use cases.
